evals.prompt: Bản vẽ Civil 3D đang mở, liệt kê các alignment và cho tôi chiều dài từng tuyến theo mét.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_civil3d_context first and reads civil3d.drawingUnit (and insunitsMismatch), then the list_alignments seed (not execute_civil3d_code), converts lengthMm to metres, reports start/end stations in the drawing unit with their labels, and pages with limit/offset when truncated.

assertions.text: get_civil3d_context is called before any other Civil 3D tool and the drawing unit is read from civil3d.drawingUnit
list_alignments is used instead of an ad-hoc execute_civil3d_code script
Lengths are converted from mm to metres and stations are reported in the drawing unit (Meters or Feet), never mixed
A truncated result is paged with offset instead of raising limit past the schema maximum

evals.prompt: Tạo alignment từ polyline handle 2F3A tên 'Tuyen-01' trong Civil 3D.
evals.expected_output: Checks the context (isReadOnly false, executionEnabled true, drawingUnit), runs create_alignment_from_polyline with dryRun=true first and shows the resulting length/stations and changed counts, asks the user to confirm, then runs it for real (transaction auto) and reports the alignment handle, name, length in mm/metres and stations, mentioning that U in Civil 3D undoes it; a duplicate name or missing layer is explained as an ArgumentException the user must fix.

assertions.text: isReadOnly / executionEnabled are checked before the write
A dryRun=true call precedes the real run and the user is asked to confirm
No script or tool attempts Rebuild/RebuildAll or a data shortcut
The answer says U in Civil 3D reverts the AI run

evals.prompt: Tool Civil 3D trả -32002 'Civil 3D is running a command or showing a dialog' dù tôi không làm gì, sửa thế nào?
evals.expected_output: Explains that -32002 means the bridge waited ~8 s for an idle editor: a running MCP script (scripts run on the main thread, so even get_civil3d_context queues behind one), a command in progress or a modal dialog (Panorama/Toolspace) in Civil 3D; advises pressing ESC / closing the dialog, waiting for the running script or calling cancel_execution, then retrying; never suggests bypassing the opt-in or editing settings.json.

assertions.text: -32002 is identified as the busy grace (editor not quiescent) rather than a failed run
Mentions that a running script blocks the context call because scripts run on Civil 3D's main thread
Advises ESC / close the dialog / wait or cancel_execution, then retry
No workaround that bypasses the opt-in or edits bridge settings is suggested
